main_text.p: quoniam iuxta Apostolum tradere oportet huiusmodi hominem satanae, ut spiritus salvus fiat in die Domini.
main_text.head: XLIX.
DE SEDE EPISCOPI.
main_text.p: QVod autem sedes in Episcoporum ecclesiis excelsæ constitutæ & præparatæ inveniuntur in throno, speculationem & potestatem iudicandi & solvendi atque ligandi à Domino sibi datam materiæ docet. Unde Salvator in Euangelio ait: Quaecumque ligaveritis super terram, erunt ligata in cælo.

p.i: Cætera desiderantur, ut & NOTINGI EPISCOPI Capitula, quæ REMEDIO adiecit.

page.notes: The initial Q is a large woodcut-style letter; the word-initial "Quod" is read as "QVod" from the scan. The line "CHRY" at right is a faint printed word, uncertain. Much of the lower page is blank or stained with no printed text.
